title: Docs site: add macOS equivalents to Windows-specific instructions (shortcuts, clicks, install, paths)

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:low
labels.description: Mechanical, one file, no new logic (issue-worker-low)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
The published site (https://neotech.github.io/Camcraft, source `site/content/`) is written from a Windows point of view. Go through it for anything Windows-specific and add the macOS equivalent next to it, so a Mac user can follow every page. Found by reading `site/content/` on main (2026-11-12):

**Keyboard shortcuts (guide/first-run.md, guide/operations.md, guide/posting.md, developers/commands.md)**
- The pages say Ctrl+N, Ctrl+O, Ctrl+Shift+O, Ctrl+S, Ctrl+Shift+S, Ctrl+P, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y. The app binds these through egui's `modifiers.command` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs`), which is **Cmd** on macOS. So the docs should read "Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z on macOS)", or use one notation with a note at the top of the guide.
- The same "Ctrl+Z undoes" wording is in UI hover hints: `op_page.rs` (Apply, Clear, Delete) and `machines_pane.rs`. Those are product strings, not docs, so they could be checked in the same pass or split into a ui follow-up.

**Mouse (guide/first-run.md)**
- "Right-click an operation to pin it": add the macOS forms (Control-click, or a two-finger click on a trackpad).
- Picking says "Ctrl+click adds an edge" (`geo_page.rs` EDGE_HINT). That reads `mods.ctrl`, the real Control key, even on macOS. But on a Mac, Control-click is the system's secondary click, so it may arrive as a right-click. Check on a Mac whether Control-click picking works, and document the modifier a Mac user should use. If it doesn't work, file a ui bug.

**Install (guide/install.md)**
- Windows has two detailed bullets; macOS has two sentences. The macOS section says the first launch "may need Control-click, then Open". On recent macOS (15 Sequoia and later) that bypass is gone: an unnotarized app is opened from **System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway** after the first blocked launch (or with `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CamCraft.app`). Check this on a current Mac and document the steps that work.
- Say where the command-line tools are on macOS (inside the `.app` bundle, or the ZIP), the way the Windows section names `camcraft-ui.exe`.
- Build from source: macOS needs the Xcode Command Line Tools (`xcode-select --install`). Windows' MSVC build tools aren't mentioned either.

**Developer pages (developers/gates.md and others)**
- Where `scripts/gate.ps1` or other PowerShell is shown, give the `cargo xtask gate ...` form, or the `scripts/gate.sh` one, alongside it.
- Any Windows paths (`%LOCALAPPDATA%`, `target\debug\deps\*.exe`, backslashes) get their macOS and Linux forms. AGENTS.md's sccache section is a model: it names each OS's cache dir.

**Not in scope:** changing the shortcuts themselves (for example, adding Cmd+Shift+Z for redo as macOS apps expect). If that's wanted, file it as a separate ui issue.

Done means: every page under `site/content/` that names a Windows key, path, file type or click gives the macOS equivalent (Linux too where it differs), and the macOS install steps are checked on a current macOS.
